lines.text: Those who walk in the Law of the LORD and seek Him with all their heart are blessed.
The writer wishes his ways were committed to God's statutes and promises to praise God with an upright heart.
A young man keeps his way pure by guarding it according to God's prophets.
The writer rejoices in God's testimonies as much as in all riches and promises not to forget God's word.
The writer asks God to remove his scorn, and he meditates on God's statutes though priests slander him.
